verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's official MCP server lets AI assistants do many core UI tasks: diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, build, edit and deploy workflows, test tools, run simulations, inspect setup, and talk to Coach. That is substantial programmatic coverage, but nothing in the evidence documents a general public API or claims parity with the UI. missing for 10: a documented public REST/programmatic API, an explicit UI-parity statement, API coverage of analytics, outbound campaigns, human handoff and admin/settings, and independent hands-on corroboration.
